_diagnostics.note: Joint per-LAYER MILP: y[layer,w,a] (sensitivity) linked to z[layer,pe,simd,ram_style,w,a] (cycles/LUT/BRAM/DSP) via a same-layer equality constraint -- LUT/BRAM/DSP are REAL hard <= XCZU7EV constraints here (not a soft penalty). Objective = alpha*mean(sens_norm) + (1-alpha)*mean(cycles_norm), both mean-normalized by the SAME n_layers. GUARANTEED to fit the requested hard budget(s) under this cost model's own calibration -- a steering signal at that calibration, not a certified hardware guarantee. Coarser than nnunetv2.nets.LayerQuantENet's own full per-quantizer-site deployment schema -- see module docstring's SCOPE BOUNDARY.
